about: Ben's framework for his research, in his own words (2 Nov 2026), lightly arranged; the definitions are his and are what the model reasons from. Edit them here; the app and the model read this file fresh.

realms.name: Economic
realms.example: worker exploitation (observation), and public prosperity is good (principle)

realms.name: Ecological
realms.example: observed abuses like burning rainforests, and the idea that nature is beautiful (a principle)

phases.name: Principle and observation
phases.words: Principles/observations is phase 1. Those are just the ideas of revolution and the complaints. Super common.

phases.name: Revolt
phases.words: Phase 2 is revolt: revolting against abuse and in favor of principle.

phases.name: Society
phases.words: Phase 3 is society: that's when the revolt succeeds and the principle becomes part of society.

phases.name: Hijacked society
phases.words: Hijacked society is phase 4. Think USSR, where a workers' revolution is hijacked.

phases.name: Revolt against the hijacked society
phases.words: Phase 5 is the revolt against the hijacked society, i.e., a revolt to make the USSR more democratic and worker-oriented, like that naval revolt in the Baltic.

systems: The three- and five-phase systems. In theory it should be only phases 1 to 3, the Hegelian thing with dialectics; but in practice, we see the five-phase system.
